cohort: 26,689 Chinese patients who underwent their first IVF cycle
finding: A nomogram incorporating female age, BMI, tubal factor infertility, male infertility, uterine factor infertility, unexplained infertility, AFC, and basal serum FSH was developed and validated to predict CLB in women undergoing their first IVF cycle, demonstrating good calibration and possibly helpful discrimination (AUC: 0.672).
